coverage: 107 votes at 23 meetings, 6 September 2017 to 13 March 2019 (FY2018-FY2019).
56 from the board's own minutes (18 of the 18 sets the town posted have been read), 33 of them matched to the recording; 51 from our minutes of a recording only.
A meeting with neither minutes read nor a recording we have written up has no votes here, which is not the same as no votes taken. Each fiscal year says how many such meetings the register knows of.
